item.title: Exploring Li growth modes in Li metal electrodes using X-ray nano-tomography
item.description:
با نانوتوموگرافی اشعه ایکس درجا، حالت‌های رشد سوزنی و ورقه‌ای لیتیوم و ارتباط آن با SEI و دانه‌های جدید نشان داده شد.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work achieves time-resolved 3D imaging of lithium metal growth inside working cells using in situ X-ray nano-tomography at sub-micron resolution. It identifies distinct needle-like and sheet-like growth modes, with elongation at tips, bases, kinks, or edges and minimal coarsening. Linking these modes to grain nucleation and SEI evolution provides unprecedented mechanistic insight into Li deposition, advancing high-energy Li-metal battery development.

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work decouples solvation from reactivity by assigning distinct molecular roles in a quaternary ester–ether electrolyte, excluding methyl propionate from Li+ coordination while an ether–anion network builds a PDOL–LiF heteromatrix interphase. 💡 This work introduces latent solvation chemistry, where a weakly coordinating diluent is recruited into the Li+ solvation shell upon cooling, dynamically adapting the electrolyte. This enables 5 C fast charging at −20°C, stable cycling at −50°C, and long pouch-cell life, offering a molecular design strategy for wide-temperature fast-charging lithium-ion batteries.

💡 High-pressure lamination is shown to be decisive for Sn buffer layers in low-pressure all-solid-state Li batteries. Decoupling lamination from stack pressure reveals that good Sn–solid electrolyte contact enables Li⁺ transport and deposition beneath the buffer, improving Li utilization, lowering overpotential, and suppressing voids and short circuits at 1 MPa.

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study uniquely links solvent impurity origins to battery performance during electrolyte scale-up, classifying impurities by synthesis pathway. It reveals a critical removal–generation trade-off in purification and identifies water, alkoxides, and amines as key degraders. The transferable qualification framework enables reliable upscaling of fluorinated ether electrolytes for lithium metal batteries.

item.title: Particle‐Level ZrO 2 Atomic Layer Deposition Enables Fast‐Cycling and Long‐Life Graphite Cathodes for Dual‐Ion Batteries
item.description:
این مطالعه نشان می‌دهد که پوشش ZrO2 به روش ALD در سطح ذرات گرافیت، کاتد باتری دو-یونی را برای ۴۰۰۰ چرخه در نرخ 5C پایدار می‌کند.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Particle-level ZrO₂ ALD on graphite particles, rather than electrode-level coating, is the key novelty. It improves cohesion, preserves electronic connectivity, enriches PF₆⁻, and facilitates anion transport, enabling 4000 stable cycles at 5 C. This establishes coating spatial location as a decisive design principle for durable, fast-cycling dual-ion battery cathodes.
🏷 dual-ion battery · graphite cathode · atomic layer deposition · ZrO2 coating · fast charging
